text:
Ivy (CS): heads-up team — we found a token->org mapping regression that surfaced during overnight private onboarding runs. a small group of tenants saw session tokens tied to the wrong org id which caused access/visibility hiccups. compiling impacted list now: https://redwood.share/inc/1769998888 :rotating_light:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-4019 | Severity: P2 | Affected: ~10 private/onboard tenants | Oncall paged

Marco (Onboard): quick summary from our side: 6 mid-onboard, 4 in final validation. 3 accounts have renewal discussions scheduled this week — high priority. several customers reported seeing other tenants' onboarding status which is...bad.

Sofia (Eng): root cause: regression in a recent token migration script that introduced an edge-case in org-id assignment when refresh tokens rotated during a rolling deploy. fix deployed at 02:30 UTC, backfilled mapping and invalidated affected tokens. we'll include a one-paragraph RCA in outbound.

Ivy (CS): comms ask: 1) immediate status note to impacted contacts with clear steps; 2) personally reach out to the 3 renewal-week accounts offering an exec sponsor call + 14 days credits and option to hold invoice until confirmed; 3) schedule mandatory security walkthrough for anyone who saw cross-org visibility. need legal ok for invoice hold language.

Ravi (AM): please add me to those three accounts. holding invoice contingent on customer confirmation is fine but run past finance. exec sponsor call offer approved for enterprise.

Jules (Legal): ok on credits and sponsor call. invoice hold language: we can offer "temporary billing hold upon request while we validate impacted data" — avoid language that promises refunds or admissions of data leakage. legal to review outbound copy within 90 mins.

Ivy (CS): draft short status note (non-technical):

"Hi <Name>,

We detected an issue affecting authentication and provisioning during last night's onboarding window that caused incorrect session mappings for a small number of customers. The issue has been fixed and mappings corrected. We're sorry for the confusion. To support your team we can offer a complimentary executive sponsor call, 14 days of account credits, and the option to place a temporary billing hold while we validate your tenant. Please reply if you'd like us to prioritize any of these.

— Ivy, Customer Success"

Sofia (Eng): RCA blurb suggestion: "Cause: regression in token migration script causing rare org-id misassignment during token rotation; Fix: patched migration, invalidated affected tokens and backfilled correct mappings; Impact window: 2026-05-06 01:50–02:30 UTC; Mitigations: added pre-flight checks, schema enforcement and alerting on mapping anomalies."

Marco (Onboard): two practical asks for calls: 1) a short troubleshooting checklist we can run live; 2) a one-click revoke + re-issue token action for customers who prefer that.

Sofia (Eng): checklist added to doc: `revoke-session -> reissue-token -> confirm tenant-only visibility`. one-click revoke tool pushed to oncall UI.

Ivy (CS): additional outreach plan: localized subject lines for EU customers (French/German); offer scheduling windows in local business hours. OpsBot — can you provide timezone-aware contact pulls?

OpsBot: pull complete — localized contacts and timezones for 10 affected tenants. Calendar links included. Tickets created: label incident-1769998888.

Ravi (AM): for the three renewal-week accounts, I'll lead the exec sponsor calls and propose the invoice hold while legal/finance validate. keep me updated on survey sentiment.

Jules (Legal): suggested text tweak: replace "incorrect session mappings" with "incorrect session associations" to be more precise. otherwise ok.

Ivy (CS): action items:
- send status email to impacted within 60 mins (owner: Ivy)
- AM outreach + exec sponsor scheduling for 3 renewal accounts (owner: Ravi)
- legal review of outbound copy (owner: Jules)
- eng to paste final RCA blurb + enable revoke tool for CS (owner: Sofia)
- ops to attach localized contact lists and create tickets (owner: OpsBot)

Marco (Onboard): we'll capture post-call feedback with a short form: 1–5 disruption scale, yes/no on whether they'd like invoice hold, free-text for concerns. flag any <=2 for immediate AM escalation.

Ivy (CS): we'll follow up with a concise RCA in 48 hours and host an optional office hour for technical teams. I’ll post the outbound copy here after legal sign-off and report back after first 5 reaches. thanks all :white_check_mark:
